name: Thatched longhouse (colombage)
description: Norman longhouse, 17 x 7.2 m: half-timbered colombage walls on a rubble-stone sill wall under a deep thatched roof with a round ridge roll. Kitchen with an open hearth and chimney stack (west), the salle (middle), and the byre with its own double door (east); rooms joined by doorways along the rear wall. Shuttered casements, ivy on the west gable.
